import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from prepare import ROOT,sha,write_json,normalize

def main():
    p=ROOT/'data-final';m=json.loads((p/'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    for name,digest in m['files'].items():
        assert sha(p/name)==digest, name
    d=pd.read_csv(p/'clean.csv',keep_default_na=False);x=np.load(p/'features.npy')
    assert len(d)==m['final']['rows']==len(x)
    assert (d.y_mal==1).sum()==m['final']['malicious']
    assert (d.y_mal==0).sum()==m['final']['benign']
    assert d.id.is_unique and d.url_key.is_unique
    assert all(normalize(u)[0]==u for u in d.url_key)
    checks={}
    for kind in ('random','domain'):
        z=np.load(p/(kind+'-encoded.npy'));a=np.load(p/(kind+'_indices.npz'))
        all_idx=np.concatenate([a[name] for name in a.files]);assert len(all_idx)==len(d)
        assert np.array_equal(np.sort(all_idx),np.arange(len(d)))
        hashes=[hashlib.sha256(i.tobytes()+j.tobytes()).digest() for i,j in zip(z,x)]
        assert len(set(hashes))==len(d),'encoded_duplicate_'+kind
        for name in a.files:
            assert set(d.y_mal.iloc[a[name]])=={0,1}
            assert (d[kind+'_split'].iloc[a[name]]==name).all()
        if kind=='domain':
            names=list(a.files)
            for i,one in enumerate(names):
                for two in names[i+1:]:assert not set(d.domain.iloc[a[one]])&set(d.domain.iloc[a[two]])
        checks[kind]={'partition_cover':'PASS','both_classes':'PASS','encoded_unique':'PASS','rows':len(d)}
    r=m['splits']['random'];n=len(d)
    assert abs(r['train']['rows']/n-.7)<2/n
    assert abs(r['test']['rows']/n-.15)<2/n
    assert abs(sum(r[k]['rows'] for k in ('model','calibration','policy'))/n-.15)<2/n
    write_json(ROOT/'data-audit.json',{'status':'PASS','final':m['final'],'checks':checks,'manifest_sha256':sha(p/'manifest.json'),
      'audit_sha256':sha(__file__),'label_semantics':'source conflicts removed; independent relabeling NOT_RUN'})
    print('DATA_AUDIT PASS',m['final'],flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Recalculate saved predictions and policy outcomes without importing the runner."""
import hashlib,json,math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import average_precision_score,roc_auc_score
from prepare import ROOT,SOURCE,sha,write_json

def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
def mask_for(prob,ids,tau,rate,policy,seed=0):
    forwarded=prob>=tau
    rows=np.flatnonzero(~forwarded).tolist();budget=math.floor(len(rows)*rate)
    if policy=='random':rows.sort(key=lambda i:(hashlib.sha256((str(seed)+'|'+str(ids[i])).encode('utf-8')).digest(),str(ids[i])))
    elif policy=='boundary':rows.sort(key=lambda i:(-prob[i],str(ids[i])))
    elif policy!='basic':raise ValueError(policy)
    forwarded[rows[:budget]]=True
    return forwarded,budget
def check(y,p2,mask,record,base=None):
    pred=(p2>.5)&mask;ben=y==0;mal=y==1
    counts={'tn':int(np.sum(ben&~pred)),'fp':int(np.sum(ben&pred)),
            'fn':int(np.sum(mal&~pred)),'tp':int(np.sum(mal&pred))}
    for k,v in counts.items():assert v==record[k],(k,v,record[k])
    tp,fp,fn,tn=[counts[k] for k in ('tp','fp','fn','tn')]
    values={'accuracy':(tp+tn)/len(y),'precision':tp/(tp+fp) if tp+fp else 0,
       'recall':tp/(tp+fn),'f1':2*tp/(2*tp+fp+fn),'fpr':fp/(fp+tn)}
    for k,v in values.items():assert abs(v-record[k])<1e-12,(k,v,record[k])
    missed=int(np.sum(mal&(p2>.5)&~mask))
    assert missed==record['additional_misses']
    assert abs(missed/mal.sum()-record['recall_loss'])<1e-12
    assert int(mask.sum())==record['t2_calls']
    assert abs(float(mask.mean())-record['t2_call_rate'])<1e-12
    assert fp<=int(np.sum(ben&(p2>.5)))
    if base is not None:
        assert np.all(mask[base])
        assert int(np.sum((mask&~base)&mal&(p2>.5)))==record['recovered_malicious']
        assert int(np.sum((mask&~base)&ben&(p2>.5)))==record['new_false_positives']

def main():
    result={'status':'PASS','cohorts':{}}
    corpus=pd.read_csv(ROOT/'data-final/clean.csv',usecols=['id','y_mal'],keep_default_na=False)
    for kind in ('random','domain'):
        p=ROOT/kind;complete=read(p/'complete.json');assert complete['status']=='PASS'
        for name,digest in complete['files'].items():assert sha(p/name)==digest,name
        settings=read(p/'settings.json');assert settings['test_used_for_selection'] is False
        train_source=ROOT/'experiment.py'
        if settings['experiment_sha256']!=sha(train_source):train_source=ROOT/'experiment-before-path-fix.py'
        assert settings['experiment_sha256']==sha(train_source)
        assert read(p/'evaluation-code.json')['code_sha256']==sha(ROOT/'experiment.py')
        assert settings['data_manifest_sha256']==sha(ROOT/'data-final/manifest.json')
        for name,digest in settings['source_files_sha256'].items():assert sha(SOURCE/name)==digest,name
        policy=read(p/'policy-frozen.json');assert policy['frozen_before_test'] is True
        for name,digest in policy['model_hashes'].items():assert sha(p/name)==digest
        r=read(p/'results.json');s=np.load(p/'test-scores.npz',allow_pickle=True)
        y=s['y'];p2=s['p2'];ids=s['id'];assert len(set(ids))==len(ids)
        test_indices=np.load(ROOT/'data-final'/(kind+'_indices.npz'))['test']
        assert np.array_equal(ids,corpus.id.iloc[test_indices].to_numpy())
        assert np.array_equal(y,corpus.y_mal.iloc[test_indices].to_numpy())
        assert set(y)=={0,1}
        check(y,p2,np.ones(len(y),dtype=bool),r['gru'])
        assert abs(average_precision_score(y,p2)-r['gru']['pr_auc_ap'])<1e-12
        assert abs(roc_auc_score(y,p2)-r['gru']['roc_auc'])<1e-12
        checks=1
        for family in ('logistic','boost'):
            probabilities=s[family];tau=policy['families'][family]['tau']
            eligible=[v for v in policy['families'][family]['candidates'] if v['recall_loss']<=.01]
            assert min(eligible,key=lambda v:(v['t2_call_rate'],v['tau']))['tau']==tau
            base,_=mask_for(probabilities,ids,tau,0,'basic')
            for mode,rate in [('basic',0),('random',.05),('boundary',.05)]:
                mask,budget=mask_for(probabilities,ids,tau,rate,mode)
                row=r['policies'][family+'_'+mode];check(y,p2,mask,row,base)
                assert budget==row['rechecked']
                assert abs(average_precision_score(y,np.where(mask,p2,-1.))-row['pr_auc_ap'])<1e-12
                assert abs(roc_auc_score(y,np.where(mask,p2,-1.))-row['roc_auc'])<1e-12
                checks+=1
            for row in r['random_seed_summary'][family]['records']:
                mask,budget=mask_for(probabilities,ids,tau,.05,'random',row['seed']);check(y,p2,mask,row,base);checks+=1
            seeds=r['random_seed_summary'][family]
            assert [v['seed'] for v in seeds['records']]==list(range(30))
            for metric in seeds['mean']:
                samples=[v[metric] for v in seeds['records']]
                assert abs(float(np.mean(samples))-seeds['mean'][metric])<1e-12
                assert abs(float(np.std(samples,ddof=1))-seeds['std'][metric])<1e-12
            for row in r['sensitivity'][family]:
                mask,budget=mask_for(probabilities,ids,row['tau'],row['rate'],row['policy'])
                baseline=probabilities>=row['tau'];check(y,p2,mask,row,baseline)
                assert row['rechecked']==budget;checks+=1
            for rate in (.01,.05,.1,.2):
                for threshold in settings['taus']:
                    pair=[row for row in r['sensitivity'][family] if row['tau']==threshold and row['rate']==rate]
                    assert len(pair)==2 and pair[0]['rechecked']==pair[1]['rechecked']
        tm=read(p/'timing.json');assert tm['warmups_per_policy']==1 and tm['repeats']==5
        positions={v:i for i,v in enumerate(ids)};ix=np.array([positions[v] for v in tm['sample_ids']])
        assert len(ix)==1000 and len(set(ix))==1000
        for name,rounds in tm['rounds'].items():
            assert len(rounds)==5
            assert sorted(row['repeat'] for row in rounds)==list(range(5))
            if name=='gru':forward=np.ones(len(ix),dtype=bool)
            else:
                family,mode=name.split('_');forward,_=mask_for(s[family][ix],ids[ix],policy['families'][family]['tau'],0 if mode=='basic' else .05,mode)
            expected_hash=hashlib.sha256(((p2[ix]>.5)&forward).tobytes()).hexdigest()
            for row in rounds:
                assert row['predictions_sha256']==expected_hash,(kind,name,'actual_prediction')
                assert row['t2_calls']==int(forward.sum())
                assert row['n']==len(ix)
                assert abs(sum(row[k] for k in ('feature_s','t1_s','routing_s','t2_s'))-row['total_s'])<1e-8
                assert row['total_s']>0
            summary=tm['summary'][name]
            for part in ('feature','t1','routing','t2','total'):
                assert abs(summary['mean_'+part+'_s']-np.mean([row[part+'_s'] for row in rounds]))<1e-12
            assert abs(summary['median_total_s']-np.median([row['total_s'] for row in rounds]))<1e-12
            assert abs(summary['amortized_ms_per_url']-np.median([row['total_s']/row['n']*1000 for row in rounds]))<1e-12
            assert abs(summary['throughput_urls_s']-np.median([row['n']/row['total_s'] for row in rounds]))<1e-8
            assert summary['t2_calls']==int(forward.sum())
        result['cohorts'][kind]={'policy_metric_records_checked':checks,'timing_rounds_checked':35,'same_budget':'PASS',
            'actual_selective_predictions':'PASS','artifact_hashes':'PASS','test_identity_and_labels':'PASS','seed_and_timing_aggregates':'PASS',
            'test_class_counts':{'benign':int((y==0).sum()),'malicious':int((y==1).sum())}}
    result['auditor_sha256']=sha(__file__)
    write_json(ROOT/'result-audit.json',result);print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

TAUS=[0,.001,.002,.005,.01,.02,.05,.1,.15,.2,.3,.5]

def metrics(y,score,pred):
    tn,fp,fn,tp=confusion_matrix(y,pred,labels=[0,1]).ravel()
    return {'n':len(y),'tn':int(tn),'fp':int(fp),'fn':int(fn),'tp':int(tp),

      'pr_auc_ap':float(average_precision_score(y,score)), 'roc_auc':float(roc_auc_score(y,score)),
      'fpr':float(fp/(tn+fp))}

def route(p,ids,tau,rate,policy,seed=0):
    mask=p>=tau
    candidates=np.flatnonzero(~mask)
    count=int(np.floor(len(candidates)*rate))
    if count:
        if policy=='boundary':
            ranked=sorted(candidates,key=lambda i:(-float(p[i]),ids[i]))
        elif policy=='random':
            ranked=sorted(candidates,key=lambda i:(hashlib.sha256(f'{seed}|{ids[i]}'.encode()).digest(),ids[i]))
        else:raise ValueError('invalid_recheck_policy')
        mask[np.asarray(ranked[:count])]=True
    return mask,count

def cascade_metrics(y,p2,mask,base_mask=None):
    pred=(p2>.5)&mask
    # Operational score: all early benign exits tie at -1, below any routed score.
    score=np.where(mask,p2,-1.)
    m=metrics(y,score,pred)
    m.update(t2_calls=int(mask.sum()),t2_call_rate=float(mask.mean()),
        additional_misses=int(np.sum((y==1)&(p2>.5)&~mask)),
        recall_loss=float(np.sum((y==1)&(p2>.5)&~mask)/np.sum(y==1)))
    if base_mask is not None:
        added=mask&~base_mask
        m.update(recovered_malicious=int(np.sum(added&(y==1)&(p2>.5))),
                 new_false_positives=int(np.sum(added&(y==0)&(p2>.5))))
    return m

    p=np.array([.01,.04,.049,.05,.2]);ids=np.array(['a','b','c','d','e'])

    cal,policy=train_test_split(rest,test_size=.5,stratify=df.y_mal.iloc[rest],random_state=45)
    partitions={'random':{'train':train,'model':model,'calibration':cal,'policy':policy,'test':test}}
    tr,he=next(GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1,train_size=.7,random_state=42).split(ids,groups=df.domain))
    va_rel,te_rel=next(GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1,train_size=.5,random_state=43).split(he,groups=df.domain.iloc[he]))

    ca_rel,po_rel=next(GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1,train_size=.5,random_state=45).split(re_idx,groups=df.domain.iloc[re_idx]))
    partitions['domain']={'train':tr,'model':va[mo_rel],'calibration':re_idx[ca_rel],'policy':re_idx[po_rel],'test':te}

def main():
    check_normalizer()
    out = ROOT/'data'
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    frames, hashes = [], {}
    for name, expected in EXPECTED.items():
        p = SOURCE/'data'/'dataset'/name
        hashes[name] = sha(p)
        if hashes[name] != expected: raise ValueError('source_hash_changed:'+name)
        df = pd.read_csv(p, dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)
        if not set(df.type).issubset({'0','1'}): raise ValueError('unknown_label')
        df['y_mal'] = 1-df.type.astype(int)
        df['source_id'] = [f'{name}:{i+2}' for i in range(len(df))]
        frames.append(df[['url','y_mal','source_id']])
    df = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    stages = [{'step':'raw', **summarize(df)}]
    raw_conflicts = set(df.groupby('url').y_mal.nunique().loc[lambda x:x>1].index)
    reasons = Counter()
    canonical, hosts = [], []
    with (out/'excluded.csv').open('w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f:
        writer=csv.writer(f); writer.writerow(['source_id','reason','url_sha256','y_mal'])
        def exclude(indices, reason):
            for row in df.loc[indices].itertuples():
                writer.writerow([row.source_id,reason,hashlib.sha256(row.url.encode()).hexdigest(),row.y_mal])
            reasons[reason]+=len(indices)
        invalid=[]
        for i,row in enumerate(df.itertuples()):
            try: key,host=normalize(row.url)
            except (ValueError,UnicodeError) as exc:
                key=host=''; invalid.append(i)
                reason=str(exc) if str(exc) in ('empty_url','control_or_format_character','unsupported_scheme','invalid_host') else 'parse_error'
                writer.writerow([row.source_id,reason,hashlib.sha256(row.url.encode()).hexdigest(),row.y_mal]); reasons[reason]+=1
            canonical.append(key); hosts.append(host)
        df['url_key']=canonical; df['host']=hosts
        df=df.drop(index=invalid)
        stages.append({'step':'invalid_and_control_removed',**summarize(df)})
        conflicts=set(df.groupby('url_key').y_mal.nunique().loc[lambda x:x>1].index)
        idx=df.index[df.url_key.isin(conflicts)|df.url.isin(raw_conflicts)]
        exclude(idx,'conflicting_label'); df=df.drop(index=idx)
        stages.append({'step':'raw_and_normalized_conflicts_removed',**summarize(df)})
        idx=df.index[df.duplicated('url_key')]
        exclude(idx,'duplicate_normalized_url');df=df.drop(index=idx)
        stages.append({'step':'normalized_duplicates_removed',**summarize(df)})
        # Inputs are canonical strings; remove indistinguishable full model inputs
        # before splitting. The GRU sees the first 50 character trigrams (52 chars).
        numeric=[]; texts=[]; reps=[]; invalid=[]
        for i,row in df.iterrows():
            try:
                features=extract_features(row.url_key)
                text=preprocess_link(row.url_key)
                if not text: raise ValueError('empty_model_text')
            except (ValueError,TypeError,re.error):
                invalid.append(i); continue
            numeric.append(features);texts.append(text)
            reps.append(hashlib.sha256((text[:52]+'|'+json.dumps(features)).encode()).hexdigest())
        exclude(invalid,'unusable_model_input'); df=df.drop(index=invalid)
        df['representation_key']=reps
        x=np.asarray(numeric,dtype=np.float32); df['feature_index']=np.arange(len(df))
        rep_conflicts=set(df.groupby('representation_key').y_mal.nunique().loc[lambda x:x>1].index)
        idx=df.index[df.representation_key.isin(rep_conflicts)]
        exclude(idx,'conflicting_model_representation'); df=df.drop(index=idx)
        stages.append({'step':'model_representation_conflicts_removed',**summarize(df)})
        idx=df.index[df.duplicated('representation_key')]
        exclude(idx,'duplicate_model_representation');df=df.drop(index=idx)
        stages.append({'step':'model_representation_duplicates_removed',**summarize(df)})
    extract=tldextract.TLDExtract(suffix_list_urls=(),cache_dir=None,include_psl_private_domains=True)
    domain_cache={}
    for host in set(df.host):
        e=extract(host)
        domain_cache[host]=(e.domain+'.'+e.suffix) if e.suffix else host
    df['domain']=df.host.map(domain_cache)
    df['id']=df.url_key.map(lambda u:hashlib.sha256(u.encode()).hexdigest())
    df=df.sort_values('id').reset_index(drop=True)
    x=x[df.feature_index.to_numpy()]
    df['text']=df.url_key.map(preprocess_link)
    df=df.drop(columns='feature_index')
    n=len(df)
    partitions=make_partitions(df)
    summaries={};audit={}
    for kind,parts in partitions.items():
        summaries[kind]={};audit[kind]={}
        assignment=np.full(n,'',dtype=object)
        for name,idx in parts.items():
            assignment[idx]=name
            summaries[kind][name]={**summarize(df.iloc[idx]),'fraction':len(idx)/n,'domains':df.domain.iloc[idx].nunique()}
            if set(df.y_mal.iloc[idx])!={0,1}:raise ValueError('class_missing')
        assert np.all(assignment!='')
        df[kind+'_split']=assignment
        names=list(parts)
        for a_i,a in enumerate(names):
            for b in names[a_i+1:]:
                cols=['id','url_key','representation_key']+(['domain'] if kind=='domain' else [])
                pair={c:len(set(df[c].iloc[parts[a]])&set(df[c].iloc[parts[b]])) for c in cols}
                if any(pair.values()):raise ValueError('split_overlap')
                audit[kind][a+'|'+b]=pair
        np.savez(out/(kind+'_indices.npz'),**parts)
    df.to_csv(out/'clean.csv',index=False)
    np.save(out/'features.npy',x)
    manifest={'source_sha256':hashes,'raw_conflicting_urls':len(raw_conflicts),'normalized_conflicting_urls':len(conflicts),
      'representation_conflicts':len(rep_conflicts),'stages':stages,'exclusion_reasons':dict(reasons),
      'final':summarize(df),'splits':summaries,'overlap_audit':audit,'feature_names':FEATURE_NAMES,
      'seed':42,'labels':{'malicious':1,'benign':0},'normalizer_tests':'PASS',
      'domain_method':'GroupShuffleSplit, offline bundled PSL incl private suffixes; actual row proportions reported',
      'label_limit':'Conflicts excluded without relabeling. Remaining source labels have not been independently adjudicated.',
      'files':{p.name:sha(p) for p in out.iterdir() if p.is_file()},'prepare_sha256':sha(Path(__file__))}
    write_json(out/'manifest.json',manifest)
    print(json.dumps({'stages':stages,'exclusion_reasons':dict(reasons),'splits':summaries},indent=2),flush=True)

"""The 18 numeric inputs in the order expected by the pinned GRU."""
import re
from urllib.parse import urlparse

FEATURE_NAMES = (
    'use_of_ip', 'abnormal_url', 'count.', 'count-www', 'count@', 'count_dir',
    'count_embed_domian', 'count-https', 'count-http', 'count%', 'count?',
    'count-', 'count=', 'url_length', 'hostname_length', 'count-digits',
    'count-letters', 'fd_length',
)

# The reference also recognizes a hexadecimal IPv4 followed immediately by
# a full IPv6 after the slash. An ordinary IPv6 on its own does not match.
_octet = r'(?:[01]?\d\d?|2[0-4]\d|25[0-5])'
_hex_byte = r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]{1,2}'
_hex_word = r'[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}'
_address = re.compile(
    r'\.'.join([_octet] * 4) + r'/|' +
    r'\.'.join([_hex_byte] * 4) + '/' + ':'.join([_hex_word] * 8)
)


def extract_features(raw_url):
    parsed = urlparse(raw_url)
    parts = parsed.path.split('/', 2)
    # The original uses the hostname as a regex, including its metacharacters.
    return [
        int(bool(_address.search(raw_url))),
        int(bool(re.search(str(parsed.hostname), raw_url))),
        raw_url.count('.'), raw_url.count('www'), raw_url.count('@'),
        parsed.path.count('/'), parsed.path.count('//'),
        raw_url.count('https'), raw_url.count('http'), raw_url.count('%'),
        raw_url.count('?'), raw_url.count('-'), raw_url.count('='),
        len(raw_url), len(parsed.netloc), sum(map(str.isnumeric, raw_url)),
        sum(map(str.isalpha, raw_url)), len(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0,
    ]

import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras.layers import Dense, Dropout, Embedding, GRU, Input, concatenate
from tensorflow.keras.models import Model

def create_model(Sequence_length,max_tokens, input_shape_numeric ):
    # define nlp model
    text_input = Input(shape=(Sequence_length,),)
    x = Embedding(max_tokens, 16, input_length=Sequence_length)(text_input)
    x = GRU(16, dropout=0.2, recurrent_dropout=0.2)(x)
    x = Dropout(0.2)(x)
    text_model = Model(inputs=text_input, outputs=x)

    # define numeric model
    numeric_input = Input(shape=(input_shape_numeric,),)
    y = Dense(16, activation='relu')(numeric_input)
    y = Dropout(0.2)(y)
    # y = Dense(16, activation='relu')(y)
    # y = Dropout(0.2)(y)
    numeric_model = Model(inputs=numeric_input, outputs=y)

    # concatenate the two models
    combined_input = concatenate([text_model.output, numeric_model.output])
    z = Dense(16, activation='relu')(combined_input)
    z = Dropout(0.2)(z)
    output = Dense(1, activation='sigmoid')(z)

    return Model(inputs=[text_model.input, numeric_model.input], outputs=output)
